title: Fixing CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED in pip behind a company proxy
text: If pip install fails with SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED on a work network, your proxy re-signs HTTPS traffic. Export your company's root CA as a .pem file, then run pip config set global.cert /path/to/company-ca.pem and retry the install.

title: pip SSL error on macOS after installing Python
text: Python from the python.org installer ships without system certificates. Open the Python folder in Applications and run Install Certificates.command, then run pip install again. The certificate error should be gone.

title: Quick workaround: trusted hosts
text: As a temporary workaround you can run pip install --trusted-host pypi.org --trusted-host files.pythonhosted.org <package>. This skips certificate checks for those hosts, so fix the certificate setup properly afterwards.

title: Using PIP_CERT in CI jobs
text: In a CI job that sits behind an inspecting proxy, set the PIP_CERT environment variable to the path of your CA bundle before the install step. pip reads it the same way as the --cert option.

title: requests: SSLError when calling an internal API
text: The requests library raises SSLError when a server uses a certificate from a private CA. Pass verify='/path/to/ca.pem' or set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE. This is about your own HTTP calls, not about installing packages.

title: How to install packages with pip
text: Run pip install <package> to install from the Python Package Index. Use a virtual environment so each project keeps its own dependencies.

title: Renewing a Let's Encrypt certificate on nginx
text: Run certbot renew --dry-run to test renewal, then reload nginx. Add a cron job or systemd timer so the certificate renews before it expires.

title: pip install hangs with no output
text: If pip install seems stuck, run it with -v to see which step is slow. Slow mirrors and large source builds are the usual causes. Try --prefer-binary to avoid compiling from source.

title: Upgrade pip to refresh its bundled certificates
text: Some SSL verification failures come from an old CA bundle. pip ships its own copy of certifi, so upgrade pip itself with python -m pip install --upgrade pip, then retry the install that failed.

title: conda vs pip: which should I use?
text: Use conda when you need non-Python dependencies managed together; use pip for pure Python packages. Mixing both in one environment can cause conflicts.

title: Git clone fails with SSL certificate problem
text: git clone over HTTPS can fail with 'SSL certificate problem: unable to get local issuer certificate'. Point git at your CA with git config --global http.sslCAInfo /path/to/ca.pem.

title: Corporate proxy settings for pip
text: pip honours HTTPS_PROXY and the --proxy option. If the proxy intercepts TLS you also need its certificate: add cert = /path/to/proxy-ca.pem under [global] in pip.conf, or pip.ini on Windows.

title: Top 10 Python IDEs this year
text: A roundup of popular editors for Python development, from lightweight text editors to full IDEs, with notes on debugging and plugin support.

title: SSL certificate expired on my website
text: Visitors see a warning when your site's certificate expires. Renew it with your certificate provider and install the new certificate on the web server.

title: Docker build: pip SSL error inside the container
text: When pip install fails with a certificate error during docker build on a company network, copy the company CA into the image, run update-ca-certificates, and set PIP_CERT=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt before the pip step.

title: Python ModuleNotFoundError explained
text: ModuleNotFoundError means Python cannot find the package in the active environment. Check that you installed it with the same interpreter you are running.

title: Why HTTPS certificates matter
text: Certificates prove a server's identity and let browsers set up an encrypted connection. Certificate authorities sign them after checking domain ownership.

title: Windows: pip certificate error after antivirus update
text: Some antivirus products inspect HTTPS traffic and cause CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED in pip. Turn off HTTPS scanning for python.exe, or export the antivirus root certificate and point pip at it with --cert.

title: Speed up pip with a local cache
text: pip caches downloaded wheels by default. Keep the cache between CI runs to avoid downloading the same packages again.

title: Poetry lock is slow
text: Resolving dependencies with Poetry can take minutes on large projects. Pin versions more tightly or update Poetry to a newer release to speed it up.
